title: SupportPanel
wrapsNative: MonarchBottomSheet with MonarchTabs and Tab; MonarchMessageRow and MonarchMessageComposer for chat; MonarchSearchResults, MonarchLink and MonarchBadge for help, contacts and status
summary: A recipe, not a component: help and support in a bottom sheet, with a Chat tab (the support conversation and a composer) and a Help tab (articles, other ways to reach the team and the system status).
whenToUse: An app offers in-app support chat, help articles or contact options from a Help entry in its navigation or settings.
whenNotToUse: For a full help center, open it as its own screen or a Custom Tab. For a single contact link, use MonarchLink in place.
api: MonarchTabs(selectedIndex = currentTab, onSelectedIndexChange = { currentTab = it }) { tab("Chat"); tab("Help") }
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class) MonarchMessageRow(author = MonarchMessageRowAuthor("Support"), time = …, timeStyle = MonarchMessageRowTimeStyle.Clock) { MonarchText(…) }
MonarchSearchResults(groups = articles, onSelect = { result, _ -> … }, modifier = Modifier.heightIn(max = …))
MonarchBadge(text = "All systems normal", tone = MonarchTone.Success); MonarchLink(text = "System status", onClick = …, external = true)

options.name: open
options.description: Whether the sheet is shown; the app's Help entry sets it.

options.name: tab
options.description: The selected tab, Chat or Help, kept in rememberSaveable.

options.name: chat
options.description: The conversation from the app's support chat client; leave the Chat tab out when there is none.

options.name: articles
options.description: Popular or matching help articles, opened in the help center.

options.name: contacts
options.description: Other ways to reach support: email, phone, a contact form.

options.name: status
options.description: The current system status as text with a tone, and a link to the status page.

states.name: chat
states.description: The conversation and the composer; sent messages appear as rows.

states.name: connecting or offline
states.description: The app shows a MonarchInlineNotice above the conversation, such as The team is away. Leave a message and they will reply here.

states.name: help
states.description: Help articles, contact links and the system status.

states.name: closed
states.description: Swiping the sheet down, tapping the scrim or system back closes it, from MonarchBottomSheet.

appearance: A Material 3 bottom sheet on the surface color with a heading, a primary tab row in the accent color, message rows, an outlined composer, result rows, links in the link color and a success badge for the status. Every part is an existing component, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web ships SupportPanel: a side sheet beside the navigation rail with Chat and Help tabs, a built-in client for its Support Chat API (connecting, offline, time-outs, resend) and links that open in new tabs. On a phone it is a bottom sheet, and the parts already exist as Monarch components, so Android keeps it a recipe. The app owns the chat connection and its states (it shows them with MonarchInlineNotice and the message rows' Pending and Failed statuses) because Monarch adds no networking. Links call back: the app opens email with an ACTION_SENDTO intent and web pages in a Custom Tab; there is no target="_blank" and no script-scheme check because no URL is loaded by Monarch. MonarchMessageRow and MonarchMessageComposer are experimental, so the recipe opts in where it uses them.
accessibility: MonarchBottomSheet moves TalkBack focus into the sheet and closes on system back, a swipe down or a tap on the scrim.
The tabs are Material 3 Tabs with the Tab role and the selected state.
Message rows read the author, time and text together, from MonarchMessageRow; the composer is a labelled text field with a Send button, from MonarchMessageComposer.
The system status is text with a tone (All systems normal), never a coloured dot alone.
Links are 48dp targets and say when they open outside the app, from MonarchLink with external.
edgeCases: Keep the sheet's content short enough to fit; the article list scrolls inside a bounded height.
Without a chat client, show only the Help content and no tabs.
While the team is away, keep the composer and say when they will reply.
